sources.supports: Every method validates its identifier, places it as the only path segment of the matching endpoint and forwards any JSON payload unchanged. The two reads parse against ConfigurationGroupSchema and ConfigurationSchema; the two deletes resolve with no value.

get_configs/{project_id} returns the configuration groups of a project, each with its configurations. add_config_group and add_config require a name; update_config_group and update_config take an optional name. Every one of these endpoints requires TestRail 5.2 or later. Deleting a group cannot be undone and removes every configuration in it; deleting either does not affect closed plans and runs, nor active ones until they are next updated.

input_policy.notes: Strictness is an MCP boundary requirement. The identifier is the only input; no body and no query are sent.

outer_result.notes: The method resolves with no value and the wrapper reports data: null. Deleting a group removes every configuration in it and cannot be undone; closed plans and runs keep what they already recorded, and active ones keep it until they are next updated.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.
Send exactly one request. The adapter never follows up with further calls to find or repair what the deletion removed.

parameters.semantics: The group to delete. No coercion; passed positionally and sent verbatim as the only path segment.

wire.encoding: Decimal integer path segment; numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.
